items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I was with the New York Philharmonic, I recorded La Mer. I remember that, because Len Bernstein was the conductor of the orchestra.

ctx.x: That’s what – I think Melvin Sparks is involved in that too. We’ll come back to that. But let’s return to this issue of – this is a jazz discography. Yet your recording career spans, as you say, commercial and other genres. What about recording with symphony or orchestras? Did – do you have . . . ?
Yeah. I remember recording. When I was with the New York Philharmonic, I recorded La Mer. I remember that, because Len Bernstein was the conductor of the orchestra.
I think I have a copy of that.
